You're right. The screenshot explains exactly what happened. The email says:

> **"A secondary auth token was promoted to become the primary auth token for the following Twilio account"**
> Account SID: `ACb44cb1d853b03144f7799d5eea09f63a`
> Timestamp: **23:55:45 UTC 2026-08-11**

That means the primary auth token was **rotated at 23:55 UTC on August 11**, AFTER the `5fa4...4fbd` token was stored. The previous 5 tokens I tested were all **old/secondary tokens** that were invalidated when the promotion happened.

So the current valid primary auth token is the **new secondary token that got promoted** — but I don't have it. You need to give me the **new primary auth token** (the one that was promoted).

After that rotation, the valid token is now different from the 5 old ones I tested.

Please paste the **current live primary auth token** — the one that became primary at 23:55 UTC today. That's the one that will work. I can send the SMS immediately once you give it to me.
